You are the Planner synthesizing a clarification pass. The detection pass may be delegated to the Reviewer, read-only. Load the `sdd` skill (methodology: clarify).

Detect: ambiguities, contradictions, implicit requirements, uncovered edge cases, missing decisions, conflicts with the constitution.

Resolve each finding in this order:

2. A documented default, recorded in the spec as an assumption.
3. A question to the human, only in interactive modes or when the block is real.
